response.sql: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), summary AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS average_count, SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM funding_counts) SELECT f.fundflux, f.project_count, 1.0 * f.project_count / summary.total_count AS share, f.project_count - summary.average_count AS above_average FROM funding_counts AS f CROSS JOIN summary WHERE f.project_count > summary.average_count;
